Name: ANIM_MOVE_CORRECTION_PARAM_ST
Description: Determines the movement correction parameters for animations.

Fields.Name: Character ID
Fields.Description: Character ID of the character to which the parameter is applied.

Fields.Name: Animation ID
Fields.Description: The animation ID of the animation to which the parameter is applied.

Fields.Name: TAE Flag ID
Fields.Description: The TAE flag this row applies to: the flag ID of the movement amount override flag.

Fields.Name: Calculation Graph Param ID
Fields.Description: ID of the correction calculation graph parameter passed to the correction movement calculation control.

Fields.Name: Character Weight: Maximum
Fields.Description: Upper limit of the AC weight passed to the corrected movement calculation.

Fields.Name: Character Weight: Minimum
Fields.Description: Lower limit of the AC weight passed to the corrected movement calculation.

Fields.Name: Character Movement: Maximum
Fields.Description: Upper limit of the movement amount passed to the corrected movement calculation.

Fields.Name: Character Movement: Minimum
Fields.Description: Lower limit of the movement amount passed to the corrected movement calculation.
